giveaways.label: Giveaways
giveaways.description: Random giveaways: prize, duration, winners, button entry.

command.end: End a giveaway now and draw the winners.
command.reroll: Reroll the giveaway (all winners, or one specific winner).

opt.channel: Channel to post the giveaway (default: here).

embed.title: 🎉 Giveaway: {prize}
embed.intro:
Click the button to enter!
**{count}** winner(s) drawn at the end.

feedback.disabled: ❌ This module is disabled on this server.
feedback.ended: ❌ This giveaway is over or cannot be found.
feedback.needRole: ⛔ You need the {role} role to enter this giveaway.
feedback.joined: ✅ You entered the giveaway! Good luck 🍀
feedback.left: ➖ You are no longer entered in this giveaway.

reroll.notWinner: ❌ This member is not a current winner of this giveaway.
reroll.noEligible: ❌ No eligible participant left to replace this winner.

giveaways.channelInvalid: ❌ Invalid channel to post the giveaway.
giveaways.sendError: ❌ Could not post the giveaway (check my permissions in the channel).
giveaways.notFoundActive: ❌ No active giveaway with that id.
giveaways.notFoundEnded: ❌ No ended giveaway with that id.

g0.description: Giveaways are created with the /giveaway command.

logChannelId.label: Log channel
logChannelId.help: A second channel where each draw's result is recorded, apart from the channel the giveaway ran in. Empty, the result only exists in the original channel — and disappears with it if that gets purged.

noWinnerMessage.label: Message when there is no winner
noWinnerMessage.help: What the bot says when the draw ends with no entrants at all. Variable: {prize} for the prize. A draw with no entrants is not a failure — it happens as soon as a giveaway is posted in a channel nobody reads.
